The bar is ~$8.1B for 2027 incl. deals (low end $7.4B + ~$0.7B), which the street already holds, so the print is two-sided: ERCOT curves vs PJM strength and 2026 'at or above the midpoint'. (2) FOMC 2026-10-27/28 after a hot September CPI (BLS: +0.6% m/m, core +0.3% m/m, +2.6% y/y), negative skew for rate-sensitive AI-power names. (3) Hyperscaler Q3 capex guides in late October (the standing capex file shows 2026 guides only went up). (4) Peer prints (CEG, NRG, TLN) and PJM's 2029/30 auction preparations and large-load compliance after FERC's 2026-10-09 order. Today's -6.5 to -7% was a sector/macro move with no Vistra news, after a +10.8% rally on 2026-10-06, so I allow only a small reversal drift. Lognormal, median $153.0 (vs $152.2), sigma 15% (base 50%/3.5 = 14.3%, slightly wider for earnings + FOMC). Offsets that keep it above NRG: 20-year hyperscaler nuclear PPAs (AWS, Meta), ~94% of 2027 hedged, investment-grade at two agencies. Same pre-SBC EBITDA basis as peers (Talen adds back stock comp). No sell-side outperformance call used.

thesis_break_reason: $118: ~22% below today and ~11% below the 52-week low ($132.66). Pro forma equity 118 x 340.6M (335.6M + 5.0M Cogentrix shares) = $40.2B + pro forma net debt $22.96B (19.16 + 2.3 cash + 1.5 assumed debt) + preferred $2.48B = EV ~$65.6B = 8.1x the $8.1B 2027 base, ~0.8x below NRG (8.9x), the cheapest IPP, and ~1.8x below VST's own ~9.9x today. Reaching it without a market-wide crash would mean something fundamental: (a) the Nov-6 or later update puts 2027 well below $8.1B (ERCOT structural oversupply), (b) PJM/FERC move to cap or administratively set 2030/31+ capacity prices, or states force re-regulation (the flagged trigger), or (c) hyperscaler AI capex cuts that erase the contracting premium. PJM cap status at 2026-10-14 (primary sources): the ~$325/~$175 collar covers only the 2028/29 and 2029/30 BRAs (FERC order 2026-04-28, ER26-1556); PJM's own answer calls it a 'limited extension' and says it will evaluate investment incentives with stakeholders by end-2026 and then 'determine the best path forward' for 2030/31 and beyond. No filing to extend or lower the cap past 2029/30 exists; NJ BPU (2026-10-01) is pushing a redesign. Flag open, not tripped. Slightly above the supervisor's $115 because my bear scenario (~$99) already assumes a 7.75x trough on lower EBITDA, and $118 still needs a multiple below every IPP on unchanged 2027 numbers.

reverse_dcf_check: Engine: the 9.5x leg ($172) implies a WACC of ~8.0% against my 9.5% build (DCF alone $126). Put differently, at 9.5% the multiple needs ~3.5% perpetual FCFF growth after FY2029 or FY2029 EBITDA ~$9.4B growing ~3% with capex near 11% of revenue. That is plausible only if data-center load keeps PJM and ERCOT prices near new-entry cost (PJM 6.8 GW short; ERCOT reserve margin falling toward 9% in 2027 per the CDR cited by Verse), and no permanent low PJM cap arrives after 2029/30. With those risks live (net about -$8.6/share probability-weighted, partly offset by contracting upside), I hold the multiple 1.1x below the IPP median and give the DCF 20%, which pulls the blend to $162.84.

reasoning: Cause of today's drop (verified): BLS released September CPI at 08:30 ET 2026-10-14 (+0.6% m/m, +3.7% y/y; core +0.3% m/m, +2.6% y/y); Reuters reported an AI-infrastructure rout; the IPPs fell together (VST -6.7%, CEG -5.6%, TLN -6.2%, NRG -5.9%) while SPY fell ~1.2% and XLU ~0.4%; EDGAR shows no Vistra 8-K since 2026-10-05. So the move is sector-wide (AI-power factor) triggered by a market-wide macro print, not company news, and does not change fair value. PJM thesis-break flag: open, not tripped; I read PJM's ER26-1556 answer myself: a 'limited extension' through 2029/30, with the 2030/31+ path to be set after an end-2026 stakeholder evaluation; no filing to extend or lower the cap. Round-2 changes after the supervisor's review: Cogentrix's $3.8B now fully in the horizon bridge (net debt incl. preferred $22.96B, built from FCFbG guidance and the call's capital-allocation plan); FY2028 EBITDA cut from $9.0B (thin FMP consensus) to $8.5B; FY2027 raised to the sourced $8.1B (unsourced $0.2B haircut dropped); multiple 10.0x -> 9.5x (below VST's ~9.9x today, 1.1x under the IPP median); P/E leg dropped; shares from the 335.6M cover count; SBC counted once as dilution; Cogentrix ~$0.7B tax NPV added (x0.9). Fair value $162.84 (EV/EBITDA $172.11 80%, DCF $125.75 20%). Scenarios: bear $98.74 (28%), base $162.84 (50%), bull $213.23 (22%), within-scenario sigma 17%; mixture median $157.7. Ladder = 80% that mixture + 20% a lognormal at the 50% realized vol around the same median, to keep fat tails. P(>= $152) = 0.542. I keep the PJM-cap probability at 0.35 (supervisor 0.4): PJM itself framed the collar as limited and has not proposed anything for 2030/31; the risk is state pressure, which is real but undecided. Industry evidence: PJM short of capacity (2028/29 BRA at the cap, 6,831 MW short; Max Gen alerts and >$1,000/MWh prices this week), FERC's 2026-10-09 rejection of IRAS/BYONC keeps capacity tight, hyperscalers keep contracting existing nuclear (Google-CEG), while ERCOT is soft (~$30/MWh; VST and NRG both flagged lower Texas prices; ~20.9 GW batteries).

inputs_detail.derivation: FY2026: TTM revenue $18,985M (F6) vs FY2025 $17,586M (F3), H1 +17.5% y/y, H2 assumed +7% -> ~$19.7B (+12%). FY2027 +8% for the Cogentrix fleet (~5,500 MW, source 34) and first Meta/AWS deliveries; then +4%/+3%. Revenue only scales D&A and capex; EBITDA is set directly from the inputs below.

Estimate, not a company figure: inside the guidance range $6.8-7.6B (guided midpoint $7.2B; CFO: 'at or above the midpoint'), built from the model margins: $7.25B / $19,696M revenue = 36.8%, less D&A 10.9% = EBIT margin 25.9%. [citation gate 2026-10-14]

Low end of the $7.4-7.8B midpoint opportunity ($7.4B; CFO: 'trending towards the lower end') + ~$0.7B Cogentrix and Meta PPAs ('add roughly $700 million ... absent any other impacts') = $8.1B. Round-1 $0.2B ERCOT haircut removed: it had no sourced curve figure behind it. $8.1B / $21,272M = 38.1% less 10.9% D&A = 27.2%.

No management 2028 figure. $8.1B + full-year Cogentrix (~$4.0B net price / 7.25x = ~$0.55B/yr, so ~+$0.1B for the part of 2027 before close) + Meta uprate PPAs and Comanche Peak AWS load from end-2027 (+~$0.3B) - ERCOT: 2028 only ~72% hedged with forwards 'meaningfully lower' and 2028/29 PJM capacity at $325 vs $333 (2027/28) (-~$0.0-0.1B) = ~$8.5B (+5%). Replaces round-1 $9.0B, which leaned on a 1-2 analyst FMP consensus.
+4%: AWS Comanche Peak ramp (full by 2032), 2029/30 capacity under the same ~$325 collar, ERCOT soft; no consensus used.

Estimate (no revenue guidance exists): 2026 D&A guidance $2,150M (incl. $423M nuclear fuel amortization, Q2 release reconciliation) / ~$19.7B estimated FY2026 revenue = 10.9%; TTM $1,852M / $18,985M = 9.8% (excl. nuclear fuel). [citation gate 2026-10-14]
TTM capex $2,866M / $18,985M = 15.1% incl. growth (peakers, uprates); stepping down as the $4.5-5B 2026-27 growth program completes.
TTM income tax $584M / pretax $2,803M = 20.8%.
FY2025 SBC $113M / revenue $17,586M = 0.64%. Not deducted from FCFF: SBC is counted once, through the share count.
F105 $19,160M (debt $19,595M - cash $435M) + preferred $2,476M (XBRL).

inputs_detail.derivation: 19,160 - 2,160 (H2-2026 Adj. FCFbG: half of guidance midpoint $4,325M) - 3,840 (2027 FCFbG ~$4,860M = 8.1B x 60% conversion (2026 guide 4,325/7,200), x 0.79 yr to Oct-14) + 3,800 (Cogentrix $2.3B cash + $1.5B assumed debt, fully counted) + 1,800 (other growth: $4.5-5B 2026-27 program less $2.3B Cogentrix cash = $2.2-2.7B, ~75% spent after 2026-06-30 by the horizon, incl. Helix calls) + 1,725 (buybacks ~$1.1B + common dividends $308M/yr (F74) x 1.29 = $0.40B + preferred dividends ~7% x $2.48B x 1.29 = $0.22B) = 20,485 + preferred 2,476 = 22,961. The Sept-2026 $1.5B junior notes are neutral to total claims (cash held or preferred refinanced).
XBRL MinorityInterest $12M at 2026-06-30 (10-Q accn 0001692819-26-000019; src 38). Re-cited: src 25 is the PreferredStockValue concept and does not show it. [citation gate 2026-10-14]
TTM interest $1,132M / debt $19,595M = 5.8%; new junior notes 7.0-7.25%. Not used in the bridge because net_debt_horizon is stated (FCFbG is after interest).
Cover-page count as of 2026-08-03 (replaces round-1 339.2M weighted Q2 diluted, F33).
335.6M + 5.0M Cogentrix consideration shares - ~6.9M repurchased (~$1.1B of the $1.2B authorization by Oct-2027 at ~$160) + ~0.9M SBC issuance ($113M/yr / ~$155 x 1.2 yr) = 334.6M.

Ke = 5.25% (10-yr ~5.28% on 2026-10-14) + beta 1.2 (judgment for a merchant IPP trading as an AI-factor stock) x ERP 5.0% = 11.25%; Kd 6.75% pre-tax (junior notes 7.0-7.25%, TTM 5.8%) x 0.79 = 5.33%; weights 70% equity ($152.2 x 335.6M = $51.1B) / 30% debt + preferred ($19.6B + $2.5B) -> 0.70 x 11.25 + 0.30 x 5.33 = 9.47% ~ 9.5%.
Load growth (ERCOT reserve margin falling, PJM shortfall) offset by new supply and the open PJM 2030/31+ design (PJM answer, ER26-1556).

NTM at 2027-10-14 = 0.21 x FY27 $8.1B + 0.79 x FY28 $8.5B = $8.41B. IPP median (CEG 11.8x, TLN 10.6x, NRG 8.9x) 10.6x and 11-peer median 10.6x, on consensus adjusted (pre-SBC) EBITDA (Talen adds back stock comp). VST today ~9.9x (EV $72.7B = 152.2 x 335.6M + 19,160 + 2,476 + 12, over ~$7.37B NTM = 0.21 x 7.25 + 0.79 x 7.4, ex-deals). 9.5x = 1.1x under the IPP median and ~0.4x under today: the horizon NTM is mostly 2028, only ~72% hedged into lower ERCOT forwards, and the PJM 2030/31+ design will be closer to decision.

Release: net price ~$4.0B after '~$0.7 billion of net present value of expected tax benefits'; not captured by the EV/EBITDA multiple or the flat 21% tax rate. x 0.9 probability the deal closes (not closed as of 2026-10-14; release expected mid-to-late 2026).
